name: Pyrenean chamois (izard)
desc: A sure-footed mountain goat-antelope that browses grass, lichens and buds on steep slopes up to about 3,000 m. It is the best-recorded large animal here.
about: The Pyrenean chamois is a goat-antelope that lives in the Pyrenees and Cantabrian Mountains of Spain, France and Andorra, and the Apennine Mountains of central Italy.
